//: The bundled 3D models: display name, category, description, credit, search tags. `file` is a path in assets/models; `shape` is a model generated in code (src/model/shapes.rs). `rotate` (degrees about x, y, z) stands a model up that comes lying down. See README.md for sources and licenses.

models.name: Utah Teapot
models.description: The teapot Martin Newell measured by hand in 1975 at the University of Utah: graphics' oldest test object.

models.name: Stanford Bunny
models.description: A clay bunny laser-scanned at Stanford in 1993 (simplified to 20,000 triangles). The scan's open bottom is left as it was.

models.name: Stanford Dragon
models.description: The XYZ RGB Asian dragon statuette, scanned for Stanford (simplified to 40,000 triangles).
models.credit: Stanford Computer Graphics Laboratory / XYZ RGB Inc.

models.name: Armadillo
models.description: A toy armadillo scanned at Stanford in 1996 (simplified to 30,000 triangles).

models.name: Happy Buddha
models.description: A laughing Buddha statuette scanned at Stanford in 1996 (simplified to 40,000 triangles).

models.name: Suzanne
models.description: Blender's monkey head, the low-poly test model every Blender user knows.

models.name: Spot
models.description: A spotted cow, with its texture. A smooth, perfectly clean mesh for testing.

models.name: Bob
models.description: A rubber duck with a hole through it, textured.

models.name: Blub
models.description: A cartoon fish, textured.

models.name: Fox
models.description: A low-poly fox from the glTF sample models, in its rest pose, textured.
models.credit: PixelMannen (CC0); rigging tomkranis, glTF conversion @AsoboStudio and @scurest (CC BY 4.0)

models.name: Torus Knot
models.description: A tube wound 3 times around a torus while circling it 7 times.

models.name: Trefoil Knot
models.description: The simplest knot that can't be untied, as a thick tube.

models.name: Klein Bottle
models.description: A bottle with no inside: its neck passes through its own wall and opens into the base.

models.name: Möbius Strip
models.description: A band with a half twist: one side, one edge.

models.name: Seashell
models.description: A logarithmic spiral of growing circles (Paul Bourke's seashell surface).

models.name: Supershape
models.description: Gielis' superformula in 3D: a seven-armed star blob.

models.name: Torus
models.description: A doughnut, with texture coordinates all the way round.

models.name: Sphere
models.description: A smooth sphere with longitude / latitude texture coordinates.

models.name: Tetrahedron
models.description: 4 triangles. The whole image on each face.

models.name: Cube
models.description: 6 squares. The whole image on each face.

models.name: Octahedron
models.description: 8 triangles. The whole image on each face.

models.name: Dodecahedron
models.description: 12 pentagons. The whole image on each face.

models.name: Icosahedron
models.description: 20 triangles. The whole image on each face.

models.name: Geodesic Sphere
models.description: An icosahedron split three times and pushed onto a sphere: 1,280 flat facets.

models.name: Menger Sponge
models.description: A cube with its middles cut out, three levels deep.

models.name: Sierpinski Pyramid
models.description: A tetrahedron made of tetrahedra, five levels deep.
